propositions: Production bugs occur when store write paths bypass canonical write seams by issuing raw git add/commit/rm outside the two sanctioned seams: store transaction/append internals and the reconciler git_adapter

A deterministic two-layer CI lint (Python AST + workflow cwd-aware) must flag raw git mutation verbs in subprocess calls and git wrapper name calls, resolving argv by intra-function local tracking to catch variable-based and opaque-argv shapes that literal-only matching would miss

Every raw git mutation hit must be sanctioned by an inline '# raw-git-ok: <reason>' marker with mandatory reason text, distinguishing seam-internal writes from disposable sandbox repos to prevent future bypasses

The authoritative hit inventory comes from report-mode bootstrap on the full tree; every hit is either remediated or reasoned-marked, covering seam internals (gitutil, event_append, txn, purge_bridge, git_adapter, _ref_lock), maintenance command _git callers, and disposable-workspace sites (eval_solver, criterion_preview, gerrit_client, opcert_service/workspace)

Lint test coverage must include variable-argv shapes (local list + splat, plain list pass), opaque-argv fail-closed case, no-tracker-context workflow negative control, and git read-verb non-firing to validate deterministic matching

Enforcement gates CI in _build-and-test.yml with a teaching message directing authors to the store write APIs (event_append, txn) or reconciler seam rather than raw git, with documented residual limitation that cross-function and dynamically computed argv remain undetectable
